reason: I know I scroll too long at night, but I'd still keep my phone on the bedside table for emergencies, so this would just be a second gadget next to it. Screen-time limits haven't stuck for me and I don't believe a nicer alarm clock changes that.
objection: I need my phone near me anyway, so it doesn't replace anything and I'd just end up scrolling on the phone as well.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that real people actually leave the phone in another room with it, plus a reliable way to still get emergency calls through to the bedside.
